summary: Complete testing of Digitalizador → CRM integration. All 7 requested features verified and working correctly. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows verified via Playwright.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Digitalizador → CRM integration fully working. Existing budget 'Test Project' by 'Juan García' (217.80€) can be used for testing. Opportunity has tags ['digitalizador', 'presupuesto'].

digitalizador_crm_button_appears.details: Button 'Crear Oportunidad CRM' appears when budget has lines. Uses data-testid='create-crm-opportunity-btn'. Purple color.

crm_modal_shows_budget_data.details: Modal shows 'PRESUPUESTO A VINCULAR' section with project name, total value (217,80 €), and line count (1 líneas · IVA 21% incluido).

creates_contact_in_crm.details: POST /api/crm/contacts creates contact with source='digitalizador' and notes referencing the project.

creates_opportunity_in_crm.details: POST /api/crm/opportunities creates opportunity with correct value (217.80€), tags=['digitalizador', 'presupuesto'], stage='lead', probability=30.

button_changes_after_creation.details: Button changes to 'Oportunidad Creada' (emerald/green color) with CheckCircle icon after successful creation.

crm_dashboard_shows_opportunity.details: CRM Dashboard shows opportunity in 'TOP OPORTUNIDADES' with correct value (218€) and contact name.

crm_contacts_shows_new_contact.details: CRM Contacts tab shows new contact with 'Lead' status, company, email, and phone from modal form.

ui_verification.digitalizador_view: Loads correctly with upload area, header controls (Historial, DTO Global, IVA, Descargar PDF)
ui_verification.historial_sidebar: Opens with search, shows saved budgets with project name, customer, date, lines count, and total
ui_verification.budget_loaded_view: Shows project name, acabado/armazón/costados, lines table, totals (bruto, base, IVA, total), action buttons
ui_verification.crm_button: Purple button 'CREAR OPORTUNIDAD CRM' with Briefcase icon, changes to emerald 'OPORTUNIDAD CREADA' with CheckCircle after creation
ui_verification.crm_modal: Purple header 'NUEVA OPORTUNIDAD CRM', budget preview section, form fields (nombre, empresa, email, teléfono), Cancelar/Crear Oportunidad buttons
ui_verification.success_message: Green banner '¡Oportunidad "Test Project" creada en el CRM!' appears after creation
ui_verification.crm_dashboard: Shows stats (contactos, oportunidades activas, ganadas, pipeline value), top opportunities list, activities
ui_verification.crm_contacts: Table with contacto, empresa, contacto info, estado, valor total, acciones columns
